text: Can you turn this pic into a headshot for me? I’ve been meaning to update my profile picture for a while and keep putting it off. It’s for LinkedIn, and I’d like it to be square. Please give me a navy blazer and a plain light grey background. I always end up overthinking profile pictures, so I thought I’d finally ask for help.
